run_marigold_depth_estimation: run monocular depth estimation on an input image using MarigoldPipeline with configurable denoising steps and ensemble size
create_colorized_depth_map: create a colorized depth map from a predicted depth map using a specified colormap like Spectral
ensemble_depth_predictions: ensemble multiple affine-invariant depth predictions by aligning scale and shift via BFGS optimization
resize_image_max_edge: resize an image to limit maximum edge length while preserving aspect ratio with a chosen resampling method
find_optimal_batch_size: find the optimal inference batch size based on GPU VRAM, input resolution, and data type
